mapper.sql: id, public_id, conversation_id, owner_id, idempotency_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, object_key, usage_type, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_file (public_id, conversation_id, owner_id, idempotency_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, object_key, usage_type, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{conversationId}, #{ownerId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{objectKey}, #{usageType}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qa_file WHERE public_id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
